title: Expanded Home Down Payment Help
summary:
*   Approved a budget increase of $330,875 for the Down Payment Assistance program.
*   This expansion boosts the total funds available for helping eligible residents with home purchases in Austin to over $13.1 million.
*   The additional funding comes from federal HOME program grants, supporting local affordable housing initiatives.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS' MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING MINUTES
THURSDAY, JULY 11,2002
The Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened on
Thursday, July 11, 2002 in the Hancock Building Board Room at the Lower Colorado River
Authority, 3700 Lake Austin Blvd. The following agenda were the AHFC items considered by the
Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors.
President Garcia called the meeting to order at 2:29 p.m.
AHFC-1. 
Approval of minutes for Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
June 27,2002.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
June 27,2002 were approved on Vice President Goodman's motion, Board Member
Dunkerley's second by a 7-0 vote.
AHFC-2 
Amend the Austin Housing Finance Corporation 2001-2002 budget by increasing the
Down Payment Assistance program line item by an amount equal to $330,875 and
amending the 2001 -2002 agreement with the City of Austin by increasing the contract in
an amount not to exceed $330,875, for a total contract amount not to exceed $13,149,919.
(Funds are available in the HOME Year 10, Fiscal Year 2001-2002.)
Ordinance No. 20020711-2 was approved on Board Member Thomas' motion, Board
Member Alvarez' second on a 7-0 vote.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 2:30 p.m. was approved on Board Member Slusher's motion,
President Garcia's second on a 7-0 vote.
